import io
import PyPDF2
BASE = b'%%PDF-1.7\n' \
    b'1 0 obj << /Count 1 /Kids [4 0 R] /Type /Pages >> endobj\n' \
    b'2 0 obj << >> endobj\n' \
    b'3 0 obj << >> endobj\n' \
    b'4 0 obj << /Contents 3 0 R /CropBox [0.0 0.0 2550.0 3508.0]' \
    b' /MediaBox [0.0 0.0 2550.0 3508.0] /Parent 1 0 R' \
    b' /Resources << /Font << >> >>' \
    b' /Rotate 0 /Type /Page >> endobj\n' \
    b'5 0 obj << /Pages 1 0 R /Type /Catalog >> endobj\n' \
    b'xref 1 5\n' \
    b'%010d 00000 n\n' \
    b'%010d 00000 n\n' \
    b'%010d 00000 n\n' \
    b'%010d 00000 n\n' \
    b'%010d 00000 n\n' \
    b'trailer << %s/Root 5 0 R /Size 6 >>\n' \
    b'startxref %d\n' \
    b'%%%%EOF'
def build(with_prev):
    data = BASE % (BASE.find(b'1 0 obj'), BASE.find(b'2 0 obj'), BASE.find(b'3 0 obj'), BASE.find(b'4 0 obj'), BASE.find(b'5 0 obj'), b'/Prev 0 ' if with_prev else b'', BASE.find(b'xref'))
    return io.BytesIO(data)
r_nonstrict_prev = PyPDF2.PdfFileReader(build(True), strict=False)
r_plain = PyPDF2.PdfFileReader(build(False), strict=False)
print('pdf_sequence', [type(r_nonstrict_prev).__name__, type(r_plain).__name__])
assert type(r_nonstrict_prev).__name__ == 'PdfFileReader'
assert type(r_plain).__name__ == 'PdfFileReader'

PYREPLAY
